_meta.purpose: Stage 5 night-watch patrol, senses and consequence chain for the waterfront counting-house break-in. Companion prose in docs/design/living-world-spec.md section 4 and the verified source draft in docs/design/data-drafts/theft-waterfront-night.draft.json.
_meta.coordinateSpace: NATIVE 640x360 waterfront px, identical to <id>.location.json. Feet are at (x, y+15). NightWatchSystem multiplies by the location world.scale exactly once.
_meta.anchorNote: Authored against the FALLBACK counting-house anchor (570,262). Everything shifts by (+26,+34) if the primary counting-house module lands in the waterfront plate layout (dependency D1).
_meta.waypointWidthNote: Every waypoint is walkable for a body 3 native px wide at feet level (y+15), not merely as a POINT. Six of the eighteen originally cleared the point test but not the body test — W3, W6, W8, W13, W16 and W18, all of them slivers against the customs shed or a godown wall — which made the guard.s own route unreachable and deadlocked him at W18 having walked seventeen-eighteenths of a perfect loop. Each was nudged 1-2px; the patrol shape is unchanged.

noise.action: walk on `wood` surface (the pier, x32-160 y184-248)

suspicious.enterWhen: player detected for >0.35s cumulative, or any noise event inside alertRadius
suspicious.behaviour: stops, turns toward the last-known point, raises the lantern (pool r40 -> r56 for 2s), walks to the point, sweeps 3s, returns to the nearest patrol waypoint and resumes

alerted.enterWhen: player detected for >1.2s cumulative while suspicious, OR player detected within 24 native px in any state
alerted.behaviour: shouts once, closes on the player at 140 world px/s. If he touches the player -> caught. If the player leaves the waterfront or reaches the transition trigger before he closes -> escape.

changes: SECOND WATCHMAN on the upper quay only, running W10->W18 in REVERSE, phase-offset half a loop. The W15 dark gap is now covered and the doorUnwatchedWindow collapses from 27.8s to ~7s.

The counting-house shutter is BARRED. Opening it now requires the `key-warehouse` item, which already exists in the world at a-famosa-gate.location.json items[1] (184,307). Without it the door interaction returns 'The shutter is barred from the inside since the last time.' and costs 2s of standing still.
The east lantern-post-96 (646,257) is relit every night regardless of dousing, and a doused lamp now raises `night-watch-alerted` immediately instead of on the guard's next pass.

sequence: Guard shout SFX, 300ms hold, fade to black over 600ms. No combat, no death screen.
Fade in at a-famosa-gate spawns.player (320,264) at 06:00 the following day, facing up toward the gate.
Capitão Rodrigues is at his 06:00 station (278,286), 42px away, facing the player. He speaks first, unprompted (see dialogueHooks.new capitao-rodrigues.night-complaint).

questState.onFirstCatch: merchants-seal returns to stage `choose-path`. The `theft` path stays available with requirements gaining `worldFlagsNone: ["theft-path-closed"]`. Journal: the attempt is recorded as a fact, not erased.
questState.onSecondCatch: `theft-path-closed` set. The theft path disappears from choose-path. payment, diplomatic and investigate-truth all remain completable — this is the fail-forward: the player has spent two nights and 40 cruzados and lost nothing that closes the quest.
